analyticsScore.title: Context Score
analyticsScore.meaning: An AI-computed composite score (0-100) synthesizing 12+ quantitative indicators. The score quantifies the structural alignment of bullish and bearish factors across multiple data dimensions.
analyticsScore.gradeA: A (80-100): Strong bullish structural alignment confirmed across multiple indicators
analyticsScore.gradeB: B (60-79): Moderate bullish alignment with favorable data convergence
analyticsScore.gradeC: C (40-59): Neutral — directional data inconclusive, mixed structural signals
analyticsScore.gradeD: D (20-39): Moderate bearish alignment with adverse data convergence
analyticsScore.gradeF: F (0-19): Strong bearish structural alignment confirmed across multiple indicators

gammaFlip.title: Gamma Flip Level
gammaFlip.meaning: The price at which market makers' aggregate gamma exposure transitions between positive (stabilizing) and negative (amplifying). This represents the critical regime-change threshold in the options market.
gammaFlip.above: Price above Gamma Flip → Long gamma environment: dealer hedging stabilizes price action
gammaFlip.below: Price below Gamma Flip → Short gamma environment: dealer hedging amplifies volatility

gex.title: GEX (Gamma Exposure)
gex.meaning: Net gamma exposure of options market makers in dollar terms. Positive GEX indicates a dealer environment that suppresses volatility, while negative GEX indicates an environment that amplifies price movements.
gex.positive: Positive GEX: Dealers long gamma → price stabilization through hedging
gex.negative: Negative GEX: Dealers short gamma → volatility amplification through hedging

maxPain.title: Max Pain
maxPain.meaning: The strike price at which aggregate option holder losses are maximized at expiration. Open interest-weighted convergence pressure toward this level intensifies as expiration approaches.
maxPain.desc: Distance (%) from current price to Max Pain level is displayed alongside.

putCallRatio.title: Put/Call Ratio
putCallRatio.meaning: The ratio of put option volume to call option volume. Above 1.0 indicates put-dominant (bearish sentiment), below 0.7 indicates call-dominant (bullish sentiment).
putCallRatio.high: Above 1.0: Put-dominant — elevated hedging activity or bearish positioning

shortInterest.title: Short Interest
shortInterest.meaning: Percentage of outstanding shares currently sold short. Elevated levels indicate significant bearish positioning, which also represents potential short-covering rally fuel.
shortInterest.high: Above 20%: Elevated short positioning — high squeeze potential
shortInterest.low: Below 5%: Low short positioning — minimal squeeze potential

darkPool.title: Dark Pool Activity
darkPool.meaning: Percentage of total trading volume executed through Alternative Trading Systems (ATS). Higher percentages indicate active institutional block trading.
darkPool.high: Above 55%: Active institutional block trading environment

impliedMove.title: Implied Move
impliedMove.meaning: The options-implied price movement range (±%) for the current expiration cycle. Represents a 1 standard deviation (67% probability) range based on ATM option pricing.

ivSkew.title: IV Skew
ivSkew.meaning: The difference between put IV and call IV, measuring the market's directional risk asymmetry. Positive values indicate elevated downside hedging demand.
ivSkew.positive: Positive skew: Elevated put premiums — downside risk concern
ivSkew.negative: Negative skew: Elevated call premiums — upside expectation dominant

squeeze.title: Squeeze Probability
squeeze.meaning: A composite probability (0-100%) measuring gamma/short squeeze potential based on OI concentration, IV skew, institutional positioning, and short interest data. Above 70% is an extreme risk zone.

aiVerdict.title: AI Verdict
aiVerdict.meaning: A Gemini 2.5 AI-generated structural analysis integrating all dashboard indicators. The three-section output covers: Current Status (factual overview), Analysis (structural interpretation), and Outlook (data-implied trajectory).

dashboardGuide.overviewDesc: <cyan>Context Score</cyan>, <gold>Gamma Flip</gold>, <emerald>GEX</emerald>, and <rose>AI Verdict</rose> provide a comprehensive structural analysis of any single ticker. Real-time options flow, institutional positioning, and quantitative indicators are synthesized into an actionable intelligence dashboard.
dashboardGuide.proTip: Cross-reference Context Score with Gamma Flip and GEX regime to identify scenarios where multiple structural indicators converge on the same directional thesis.
dashboardGuide.indicatorsDesc: 12 indicators derived from options market microstructure are displayed as independent cards. Cross-referencing between indicators enables multi-dimensional market structure analysis.

netGex.title: NET GEX
netGex.desc: The <cyan>net aggregate gamma exposure</cyan> held by market makers. This figure influences the market's inherent stability and directional sensitivity, reflecting the market's structural character in real time.
netGex.positive: Positive → Dealer long gamma → Self-stabilizing mechanism active
netGex.negative: Negative → Dealer short gamma → Self-destabilizing mechanism active
netGex.tip: Sign transitions represent regime changes where the market's structural character fundamentally shifts
netGex.guide1: In positive environments, dealer counter-directional hedging dampens price moves, and range-bound behavior is observed
netGex.guide2: In negative environments, dealer co-directional hedging amplifies price moves, and trend persistence is statistically elevated
netGex.guide3: When a sign transition occurs, the existing regime ends and a new volatility regime begins

gammaFlip.title: GAMMA FLIP
gammaFlip.desc: The <gold>critical price at which market maker gamma positions transition from long to short</gold>. Dealer hedging direction reverses at this level, fundamentally altering market volatility characteristics.
gammaFlip.tip: SHORT label indicates current price has entered the short gamma zone, where structural conditions for sharp bi-directional moves are established
gammaFlip.guide1: Below Flip: Dealers hedge against price direction, producing natural dampening effects
gammaFlip.guide2: Above Flip: Dealers hedge with price direction, amplifying the magnitude of moves
gammaFlip.guide3: Within ±2% of Flip, a regime transition from current to opposite state is imminent

squeeze.title: SQUEEZE
squeeze.desc: A <gold>gamma squeeze probability</gold> calculated from options positioning data. Displayed as percentage and grade (LOW/MED/HIGH), quantifying the structural conditions for non-linear price moves.
squeeze.high: HIGH — 58%+ squeeze alert, prepare for sharp moves
squeeze.guide1: In HIGH states, even minor catalysts can trigger cascading forced hedging — classified as an elevated-risk zone
squeeze.guide2: In MED states, latent energy is accumulating and the key factor is whether an external catalyst emerges
squeeze.guide3: In LOW states, options structure is stable and price moves within natural ranges

vwap.title: VWAP Distance
vwap.desc: The deviation between current price and <cyan>VWAP (Volume-Weighted Average Price)</cyan>. A key benchmark used by institutional participants to measure intraday execution quality; the degree of deviation can indicate shifts in short-term supply-demand pressure.
vwap.above: Positive → Above VWAP → Average buyer in profit
vwap.below: Negative → Below VWAP → Average buyer at loss
vwap.tip: Near-zero deviation represents a VWAP test zone; the resolution direction at this point tends to determine short-term trend
vwap.guide1: Above +2% deviation indicates overextension relative to average cost, a zone where profit-taking pressure is statistically observed
vwap.guide2: Within ±0.3% is the institutional benchmark contest zone — the breakout direction warrants close attention
vwap.guide3: Below -2% deviation indicates average cost underperformance, with structurally dominant downside pressure

maxPain.title: MAX PAIN
maxPain.desc: The price at which total option holder losses are maximized, calculated from open interest distribution. As expiration approaches, spot prices tend to converge toward this level — known as the 'pinning effect'.
maxPain.guide1: Within 48 hours of expiration: the greater the deviation from Max Pain, the stronger the convergence pressure observed
maxPain.guide2: Price ≈ Max Pain: Price is already in convergence state; the probability of sideways movement until expiration is statistically elevated
maxPain.guide3: Post-expiration: the gravitational effect of the prior Max Pain dissipates and a new convergence point forms for the next cycle

callWall.title: CALL WALL
callWall.desc: The strike price with the highest concentration of call open interest. Tends to function as an <cyan>upside resistance level</cyan> in options structure; a breakout above this level can trigger a gamma cascade where dynamic dealer hedging accelerates the upward move.
callWall.guide1: Approaching Call Wall: large call selling inventory creates structural friction against upward movement
callWall.guide2: Breaking above Call Wall: dealer gamma hedging demand generates additional buy-side liquidity
callWall.guide3: Put Floor: the symmetrical counterpart to Call Wall, serving as downside support at concentrated put selling strikes

darkPool.title: DARK POOL %
darkPool.desc: The proportion of total volume executed through <gold>institutional off-exchange (ATS) channels</gold>. The level and directional changes of this ratio indirectly reveal institutional positioning intent.
darkPool.guide1: Above 50% indicates institutional-grade participants executing large block orders while minimizing market impact
darkPool.guide2: Rising ratio + declining price: suggests institutions are accumulating shares during the decline
darkPool.guide3: Rising ratio + rising price: suggests institutions are distributing holdings during the advance

shortVol.title: SHORT VOL %
shortVol.desc: The ratio of short-sale volume to total intraday volume. Higher ratios indicate the intensity of downside selling pressure, and foreshadow the potential magnitude of <gold>forced short-covering</gold> demand upon price reversal.
shortVol.guide1: Above 40% + rising price: short-covering pressure is structurally accumulating against short positions
shortVol.guide2: Above 40% + falling price: short-led downtrend is active with sustained downside pressure
shortVol.guide3: Cross-referencing with Dark Pool ratio is effective — DP↑ + Short↑ together suggests institutional-grade short construction

atmIv.title: ATM IV
atmIv.desc: The <cyan>implied volatility of at-the-money (ATM) options</cyan> based on current stock price. A premium indicator reflecting how the entire options market assesses the magnitude of future price movement in real time.
atmIv.guide1: IV spike zones: the market is pricing in a major event or unexpected volatility, with expanded premiums
atmIv.guide2: IV trough zones: low volatility expectations with compressed option premiums
atmIv.guide3: IV fluctuation around earnings follows a typical pattern — pre-announcement spike, post-announcement collapse (IV Crush)

pcRatio.title: P/C RATIO
pcRatio.desc: The <cyan>ratio of put option volume to call option volume</cyan>. Above 1.0 indicates put-dominant (bearish) trading; below 1.0 indicates call-dominant (bullish) trading.
pcRatio.guide1: Extreme call dominance below 0.7 reflects concentrated optimism — historically a precursor to corrections
pcRatio.guide2: Extreme put dominance above 1.3 reflects peak fear — historically a precursor to rebounds
pcRatio.guide3: The 0.8–1.2 range represents neutral sentiment; cross-analysis with GEX, Squeeze, and other derivative indicators is recommended

gexRegime.title: GEX REGIME
gexRegime.desc: A <gold>gamma regime diagnostic indicator</gold> quantifying current price position relative to Gamma Flip. Displayed as a percentage, it captures whether the market sits in a stable (long gamma) or unstable (short gamma) zone.
gexRegime.guide1: Below 50%: transition zone near Flip level, where gamma regime change probability is elevated
gexRegime.guide2: 50–80%: stable zone well-separated from Flip, where the current gamma regime is likely to persist
gexRegime.guide3: Checking GEX Regime alongside Flip price deviation enables quantitative assessment of distance to the transition threshold

impliedMove.title: IMPLIED MOVE
impliedMove.desc: The <cyan>expected price movement range through next expiration</cyan>, reverse-calculated from ATM option premiums. Displayed as ±%, the options market statistically estimates ~68% (1σ) probability that price remains within this range.
impliedMove.guide1: IM ±1.4% or less: options market pricing low volatility, range-bound environment expected
impliedMove.guide2: IM ±3% or more: options market pricing high volatility, large directional move expected
impliedMove.guide3: Call premium > Put implies upside skew; Put > Call implies downside skew. IV Skew direction reveals asymmetry in market expectations

volRegime.title: VOL REGIME
volRegime.desc: Combines Gamma Exposure (GEX), Implied Volatility (IV), and Squeeze Probability to classify the current <gold>market volatility regime</gold> into 4 tiers. Quantified as a 0–100 Score derived directly from options dealer hedging structure — the metric institutional risk managers check first.
volRegime.loaded: LOADED — Volatility at critical threshold, prepare for breakout
volRegime.erupting: ERUPTING — Extreme volatility, maximum risk zone
volRegime.tip: In LOADED/ERUPTING states, small catalysts can trigger non-linear price movements due to dealer short-gamma positioning — the structural characteristic that institutional risk managers prioritize.
volRegime.guide1: STABLE: Dealer hedging tends to revert prices toward VWAP, creating a mean-reversion environment
volRegime.guide2: COILING: Compressed volatility accumulates energy; breakout moves tend to be amplified
volRegime.guide3: LOADED/ERUPTING: Dealer short-gamma deepens, creating structural conditions for bi-directional sharp moves

conviction.title: CONVICTION MATRIX
conviction.desc: Weighted aggregation of <cyan>moving average trends</cyan>, VWAP position, P/C Ratio, gamma exposure, and options flow — a <gold>directional conviction score</gold> from 5 independent data sources. Grades A through F to intuitively convey data alignment, implementing institutional multi-source confirmation methodology.
conviction.bear: D–F (0-44) — Bearish dominance, concentrated sell signals
conviction.tip: Conviction 80+ combined with VOL REGIME STABLE indicates 5 sources are stably aligned — a high-conviction structural environment.
conviction.guide1: Grade A: All 5 data sources converge in the same direction, structurally elevating trend continuation probability
conviction.guide2: Grade C: Data conflict detected — a transitional state with low directional confidence
conviction.guide3: Grade F: Multiple sources converge bearish, indicating structurally elevated downside risk

vwapCard.title: VWAP
vwapCard.desc: The deviation (%) between <cyan>Volume-Weighted Average Price</cyan> and current price. The industry-standard execution benchmark used by institutional participants to measure execution quality — its sign and magnitude reveal <gold>short-term supply/demand structure</gold>. A core reference at global hedge fund trading desks.
vwapCard.above: Positive (+) — Above VWAP — Average buyer in profit
vwapCard.below: Negative (−) — Below VWAP — Average buyer in loss
vwapCard.tip: VWAP deviation within ±0.3% is the institutional benchmark battleground — the resolution direction at this level determines short-term trend.
vwapCard.guide1: +2% deviation: Average participants hold significant unrealized gains; profit-taking supply likely
vwapCard.guide2: ±0.5%: VWAP battleground zone — whether close forms above or below VWAP is the key observation
vwapCard.guide3: −2% deviation: Average participants underwater; additional decline may trigger stop-loss cascades

shortSqueeze.title: SHORT SQUEEZE
shortSqueeze.desc: Aggregates Short Interest (SI%), Days to Cover, and short volume concentration to classify <rose>squeeze probability</rose> into tiers. Quantifies the potential magnitude of involuntary buying demand when forced covering occurs — a mandatory monitoring element in institutional risk management systems.
shortSqueeze.low: LOW — SI% below 5%, squeeze probability minimal
shortSqueeze.tip: Days to Cover 3+ combined with SI% 15%+ creates the classic structure where short-cover demand can concentrate in a compressed timeframe.
shortSqueeze.guide1: HIGH/CRITICAL: Price increases can cascade forced covering, triggering non-linear rallies through self-reinforcing loops
shortSqueeze.guide2: Positive momentum + HIGH SI%: Price rise triggers covers, covers trigger further rises — a self-reinforcing feedback loop
shortSqueeze.guide3: LOW: Short interest impact on price is negligible; prioritize fundamental and technical analysis

analystTarget.title: ANALYST TARGET
analystTarget.desc: Displays <emerald>analyst opinion distribution</emerald> and 12-month price target consensus (Average/High) from major investment banks and research houses. Tracks the 5-tier distribution alongside Wall Street's collective research judgment in real-time.
analystTarget.tip: Buy opinions above 80% indicate strongly converged consensus. Consider both whether the consensus is already priced in and the crowding risk from a lack of dissenting views.
analystTarget.guide1: 12-Month Target: Assess upside potential through the gap between current price and analysts' average (Target) and highest (High) price targets
analystTarget.guide2: Buy 90%+: Research community outlook extremely converged — strong consensus serves as a medium-term bullish foundation
analystTarget.guide3: Buy 50–70%: Dispersed opinions suggest data permits multiple interpretations — an uncertain phase

related.title: RELATED
related.desc: Displays real-time performance of industry peers with <cyan>high statistical correlation</cyan>. Instantly distinguish sector-wide capital flows from individual stock events — delivering the same correlation analysis that institutional traders monitor continuously.
related.positive: Same direction — Sector-wide common factors at work
related.divergent: Different direction — Stock-specific factors driving price
related.tip: When all related stocks move together but the target diverges, it signals a decoupling structure where individual catalysts override sector trends.
related.guide1: Sector co-movement: Macro/sector flows dominate price action over individual fundamentals
related.guide2: Leader-only advance: Intra-sector rotation underway; whether it spreads to laggards is the key question
related.guide3: Decoupling: Stock-specific catalyst overrides sector trend

instRadar.title: INST RADAR
instRadar.desc: Combines <purple>dark pool trading ratios</purple> and <cyan>block trade frequency</cyan> to classify institutional Accumulation/Distribution patterns into 3 tiers. Infers institutional positioning intent invisible to public markets — data typically accessible only through institutional-only terminals.
instRadar.accum: ACCUMULATION — Dark pool 40%+ & Block 3+ — Institutional buying indicated
instRadar.neutral: NEUTRAL — Normal range, no institutional anomalies detected
instRadar.dist: DISTRIBUTION — Dark pool 20%− & Block 1− — Institutional selling indicated
instRadar.tip: ACCUMULATION coinciding with Buy consensus indicates both institutional execution and research views are aligned — a powerful structural agreement.
instRadar.guide1: ACCUMULATION: Large volumes aggregating off-exchange, indicating non-public institutional buying intent
instRadar.guide2: DISTRIBUTION: Institutional supply entering the market; selling may continue even during rallies
instRadar.guide3: NEUTRAL: Institutional participation at normal levels; retail flow plays the dominant price-setting role

trendPhase.title: TREND PHASE
trendPhase.desc: Diagnoses the current trend phase based on <emerald>SMA 50/200 crossover state</emerald>. Golden Cross and Dead Cross are the technical reference points institutional portfolio managers use for medium-to-long-term asset allocation — SIGNUM delivers these with real-time levels and deviation percentages.
trendPhase.golden: GOLDEN — SMA 50 > SMA 200, medium-term bullish transition
trendPhase.dead: DEAD — SMA 50 < SMA 200, medium-term bearish transition
trendPhase.neutral: NEUTRAL — No crossover, existing trend tentatively maintained
trendPhase.tip: Golden Cross + CONVICTION Grade A: Technical trend and multi-source data confirm the same direction — a structurally powerful setup.
trendPhase.guide1: Golden Cross: 50-day average crossed above 200-day — technical confirmation of medium-term bullish momentum
trendPhase.guide2: Dead Cross: 50-day average fell below 200-day — technical warning of medium-term bearish transition
trendPhase.guide3: SMA gap within 3%: Two averages converging, crossover imminent — a transitional zone

fundamental.title: FUNDAMENTAL
fundamental.desc: Composite <emerald>financial health score</emerald> integrating <cyan>P/E</cyan>, <gold>ROE</gold>, free cash flow, revenue growth, operating margin, and debt ratio. Automated quantitative analysis applying institutional analyst valuation frameworks — instantly accessible as 0–100 / A–F grade.
fundamental.aGrade: Grade A (80+) — Financially excellent, growth-profitability balance
fundamental.bGrade: Grade B (60-79) — Solid with minor weaknesses
fundamental.cGrade: Grade C or below — Improvement needed, risk flagged
fundamental.tip: P/E discounted vs. sector average combined with ROE above 20% suggests undervaluation relative to earnings power.
fundamental.guide1: Grade A: Growth, profitability, and stability all strong — structural fundamental advantage confirmed
fundamental.guide2: Grade B: Most metrics solid but specific areas require attention — a mixed picture
fundamental.guide3: Grade C−: Structural financial vulnerabilities confirmed; price likely driven by speculative flow

earnings.title: EARNINGS
earnings.desc: Displays the next <gold>quarterly earnings date</gold> and time (BMO/AMC), estimated EPS, and the recent quarter's <emerald>Earnings Surprise (Beat/Miss)</emerald>. It features an Est EPS mode before the announcement that automatically transitions into a <cyan>real-time Actual EPS mode</cyan> on the release day, offering a Bloomberg Terminal-level experience.
earnings.upcoming: Pre-Release Mode (Est EPS) — Displays estimated EPS and prior quarter surprise
earnings.surprise: Post-Release Mode (Actual EPS) — Real-time update with actual EPS and current quarter surprise
earnings.tip: IV typically surges D-3 onwards; post-announcement, uncertainty resolution frequently triggers IV Crush.
earnings.guide1: BMO / AMC: Specifies whether the announcement is Before Market Open or After Market Close, helping you time the volatility phase
earnings.guide2: Pre-Release (Est EPS): Evaluates the structure by referencing next quarter's estimated EPS alongside the surprise (Beat/Miss %) recorded during the last announcement
earnings.guide3: Post-Release (Actual EPS): Switches automatically to Actual mode on release day, instantly exposing the magnitude of the current quarter's Beat/Miss

ivSkew.title: IV SKEW
ivSkew.desc: Quantifies the <cyan>implied volatility differential</cyan> between call and put options. Reveals the directional premium bias paid by market participants, reflecting the real-time balance between <gold>institutional hedging demand vs speculative positioning</gold>. Skew direction exposes the risk asymmetry as perceived by the options market.
ivSkew.putRich: PUT RICH — Put IV > Call IV — Downside hedging demand dominant
ivSkew.callRich: CALL RICH — Call IV > Put IV — Upside speculative demand dominant
ivSkew.neutral: NEUTRAL — Skew balanced — No directional bias detected
ivSkew.tip: PUT RICH + rising price is the classic structure where smart money builds downside protection during rallies — capturing institutional risk management behavior beneath surface-level bullishness.
ivSkew.guide1: PUT RICH: Elevated put premiums signal active institutional downside protection — heightened latent risk perception
ivSkew.guide2: CALL RICH: Elevated call premiums indicate concentrated upside speculation — monitor for reversal potential at extremes
ivSkew.guide3: Rapid skew reversal: PUT→CALL or reverse within 24h signals structural directional shift in institutional positioning

commandGuide.chartDesc: Overlays Call Wall, Max Pain, Put Floor, and Prev Close levels on a <cyan>multi-timeframe price chart</cyan>. Instantly visualize <gold>support/resistance zones</gold> defined by options structure. Switchable across 1D/5D/1M/6M/1Y/All — integrating institutional-grade options level analysis directly into the chart.
commandGuide.signalDesc: <gold>Composite signal analysis engine</gold>. Displays detected structural events (Golden Cross, IV Spike, Consensus Shift) as summary badges. After market close, auto-generates AI comprehensive analysis reports combining SMA, news, and flow data.
commandGuide.flowDesc: Tracks <emerald>real-time options capital flows</emerald>. Combines Call/Put premium differential (Net Premium) with execution intensity (Volume Strength) to capture large participant <gold>directional positioning</gold> in real-time — a core feature delivering institutional options flow data to individual investors.
commandGuide.gammaDesc: Provides <gold>structural price levels</gold> derived from options open interest and <cyan>gamma profile analysis</cyan>. Support/Resist/Max Pain define the short-term price range while Net GEX direction and Gamma Flip structurally classify the current market environment.

gexTimelineSection.title: GEX TIMELINE 30D / TECH LEVELS / IV SKEW / 13-F
gexTimelineSection.subtitle: 4-Tab Analytical Intelligence Panel
gexTimelineSection.desc: The core analytical panel of the Command terminal. <cyan>Four independent tabs</cyan> illuminate market structure from different time horizons and analytical perspectives. Each tab delivers the same caliber of analysis referenced daily by institutional trading desks.
gexTimelineSection.gexDesc: Visualizes 30 days of <emerald>Gamma Exposure (GEX) evolution</emerald> as a time series. gexTimelineSection.techDesc: SMA50, SMA200, VWAP, Max Pain, Call Wall, Put Floor, <purple>Gamma Flip</purple> — 7 technical and derivative levels <cyan>arranged on the price axis</cyan> to visualize the structural position of current price. gexTimelineSection.ivSkewDesc: Visualizes <gold>call/put implied volatility</gold> across strike prices as a curve. gexDeepDive.title: GEX TIMELINE 30D — Deep Dive
gexDeepDive.subtitle: Per-Ticker 30-Day Gamma Exposure Historical Analysis
gexDeepDive.desc: Tracks the evolution of each ticker's gamma structure through <cyan>30 days of daily GEX data</cyan> accumulated in DynamoDB. Delivers <gold>SpotGamma-tier ($300+/mo) historical GEX tracking</gold> that is typically gated behind expensive institutional data subscriptions.

percentileGauge.title: A. Percentile / Regime
percentileGauge.desc: Visualizes the current GEX value's <cyan>percentile within the 30-day distribution</cyan> on a gradient gauge. The spectrum spans from Negative GEX (left) to Positive GEX (right) with the current position marked.
percentileGauge.extremeLow: ≤ 10th — Extreme low; gamma exposure at historical bottom
percentileGauge.depressed: ≤ 25th — Depressed; dealer gamma exposure in weak environment
percentileGauge.elevated: ≥ 75th — Elevated; dealer gamma exposure in strong environment
percentileGauge.extremeHigh: ≥ 90th — Extreme high; gamma exposure at historical peak

regimePersistence.title: B. Regime Persistence
regimePersistence.desc: Compares the current <gold>POSITIVE/NEGATIVE regime's consecutive session count</gold> against the historical average duration for that regime. A <cyan>Current-to-Average ratio</cyan> exceeding 1.5× structurally indicates regime fatigue.
regimePersistence.aboveAvg: Extended beyond average (1.5×+) — Elevated volatility magnitude at regime transitions
regimePersistence.belowAvg: Below average — Additional regime persistence structurally possible

keyLevels.title: Key Levels
keyLevels.desc: Displays <rose>Call Wall (overhead resistance)</rose> and <cyan>Gamma Flip Level (regime transition pivot)</cyan> extracted from the 30-day history as card-format metrics.
keyLevels.callWall: Call Wall — Maximum call OI concentration price. The percentage of 30-day sessions where price remained below this level (Hit Rate) is displayed alongside.
keyLevels.gammaFlip: Gamma Flip Level — The price historically coinciding with dealer hedging regime transitions. Dealer gamma exposure switches between long ↔ short at this boundary.

flipEvents.title: Flip Events (Regime Transitions)
flipEvents.desc: Records <gold>POSITIVE ↔ NEGATIVE regime transitions</gold> within the 30-day window. Each event displays the transition date, direction (NEG→POS / POS→NEG), and price at transition.
flipEvents.toPositive: NEG→POS — Short gamma to long gamma transition; stabilization regime begins
flipEvents.toNegative: POS→NEG — Long gamma to short gamma transition; volatility amplification regime begins

dynamicInsight.title: Dynamic Insight
dynamicInsight.desc: Auto-generates <cyan>3 multi-line insight statements</cyan> from accumulated 30-day data. Regime status, Call Wall accuracy, and Gamma Flip Level context are delivered in compliance-safe language.
dynamicInsight.regimeLine: GEX value + percentile + consecutive regime session count summary
dynamicInsight.wallLine: Call Wall price + historical accuracy (hit rate) quantified
dynamicInsight.flipLine: Gamma Flip Level + historical regime transition context

gexDeepDive.guide1: <emerald>Percentile 75th+ + Long POSITIVE Streak</emerald> → Dealer gamma structure sustainably stable; <gold>range-bound observation in volatility-suppressed environment</gold>
gexDeepDive.guide2: <rose>Percentile ≤ 10th + Multiple Flip Events</rose> → Extreme short gamma with frequent regime transitions; <cyan>bi-directional sharp movement risk at structural maximum</cyan>
gexDeepDive.guide3: <emerald>Call Wall Hit Rate ≥ 80% + CW Trend ↑</emerald> → High resistance reliability + institutional upward positioning; <gold>current structural analysis accuracy elevated</gold>

inst13fDeepDive.title: 13-F INSTITUTIONAL HOLDINGS — Deep Dive
inst13fDeepDive.subtitle: SEC Form 13-F Based Institutional Ownership Analysis
inst13fDeepDive.desc: Tracks <cyan>quarterly equity positions</cyan> of institutional investors managing over $100 million in assets, based on mandatory <gold>SEC Form 13-F</gold> filings. whatIs.title: What is a 13-F Filing?
whatIs.desc: SEC Form 13-F is a mandatory quarterly report filed by institutional investment managers with <cyan>assets under management (AUM) exceeding $100 million</cyan>. Required under Section 13(f) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, it <gold>publicly discloses institutional equity positions</gold> as a regulatory mechanism for market transparency.
whatIs.filing: Filing Obligation: AUM $100M+ institutional managers — mutual funds, hedge funds, pension funds, insurance companies, bank trust departments
whatIs.deadline: Filing Deadline: Within 45 days of quarter end (e.g., Q1 due by May 15)
whatIs.content: Reported Data: Equity holdings, share count, market value, voting authority type

dataPoints.title: Data Points Provided
dataPoints.desc: SIGNUM processes 13-F data collected from SEC EDGAR to deliver <cyan>per-institution ownership profiles</cyan> in an intuitive format.
dataPoints.holders: Top Holders — Ranked institutional investors by position size and share count
dataPoints.shares: Shares Held — Per-institution share count with quarter-over-quarter changes
dataPoints.value: Market Value — Quarter-end market value of holdings ($)
dataPoints.weight: Portfolio Weight — Percentage weight of the stock within each institution's total portfolio (%)
dataPoints.change: QoQ Change — Quarter-over-quarter position changes (New Entry / Increased / Decreased / Sold Out)

interpretation.title: Interpretation Framework
interpretation.desc: 13-F data provides <gold>quarterly snapshots</gold>; structural insight precision increases significantly when cross-referenced with SIGNUM's real-time indicators rather than used in isolation.
interpretation.accumulation: Multiple large institutions simultaneously increasing positions → Institutional accumulation structure indicated
interpretation.distribution: Multiple institutions simultaneously reducing positions → Institutional distribution structure indicated
interpretation.concentration: Top 10 institutions holding 50%+ combined → High ownership concentration means large institutional position changes carry structurally outsized price impact
interpretation.crossRef: 13-F accumulation pattern + INST RADAR ACCUMULATION + CONVICTION Grade A simultaneous confirmation → Institutional execution and research views aligned in the same direction — a powerful structural consensus

limitations.title: Important Limitations
limitations.desc: Structural limitations that must be understood when interpreting 13-F data.
limitations.delay: 45-Day Lag: Filed within 45 days after quarter end, meaning published positions may reflect holdings up to 4.5 months old. Current holdings may differ materially.
limitations.snapshot: Quarterly Snapshot: Reflects holdings at a single point in time (quarter end). Intra-quarter trading activity (e.g., round-trip trades, mid-quarter buys followed by sells) is not captured.
limitations.incomplete: Incomplete Positions: Short positions, most options, bonds, and foreign securities are excluded from 13-F reporting. Therefore, the filing does not reflect an institution's complete positioning.
limitations.confidential: Confidential Treatment: Some institutions may request SEC confidential treatment to delay disclosure of specific positions.

inst13fDeepDive.guide1: <emerald>Top 5 institutional holdings increasing + multiple new entrants QoQ</emerald> → Structural institutional accumulation underway; <gold>reliability increases when cross-confirmed with INST RADAR ACCUMULATION signal</gold>
inst13fDeepDive.guide2: <rose>Large institution position cuts (>20%) + institutions exiting entirely QoQ</rose> → Structural institutional departure observed; <cyan>strengthened distribution signal when accompanied by declining dark pool ratios</cyan>
inst13fDeepDive.guide3: <emerald>Growing number of institutional holders + stable average position weight</emerald> → Broadening institutional participation with diversifying ownership structure. <gold>A positive signal as single-institution concentration risk decreases</gold>

insiderDeepDive.title: SEC FORM 4 INSIDER TRADING — Deep Dive

insiderDeepDive.desc: SEC Form 4 mandates that corporate insiders (officers, directors, 10%+ shareholders) <gold>disclose equity transactions within 2 business days</gold>. whatIs.title: What is Form 4?
whatIs.desc: Under Section 16(a) of the Securities Exchange Act, insider equity transactions must be <cyan>reported to the SEC within 2 business days</cyan>. Unlike 13-F filings (45-day lag), Form 4 provides <gold>near-real-time disclosure</gold>, making it the fastest regulatory data source for capturing insider conviction levels.
whatIs.obligation: Filing Obligation: All equity transactions by officers (CEO/CFO/COO), board members, and 10%+ beneficial owners
whatIs.codes: Transaction Codes: P (open market purchase), S (open market sale), A (stock option exercise), M (option conversion) — distinguishing transaction types
whatIs.tenb51: 10b5-1 Distinction: Pre-scheduled automatic trades (Rule 10b5-1) are clearly separated from voluntary discretionary trades, differentiating signal quality

research.title: Academic Research Foundation
research.desc: The informational value of insider trading has been empirically validated through decades of academic research.
research.seyhun: Seyhun (1986, Journal of Financial Economics) — Statistically significant abnormal return patterns have been documented following insider transactions, with particularly stronger patterns recorded for voluntary purchases by C-level executives
research.lakonishok: Lakonishok & Lee (2001, Review of Financial Studies) — Insiders exhibit contrarian investment patterns, with purchase signals showing higher informational value in smaller-capitalization stocks. In large-cap stocks, the informational value has been recorded as comparatively limited
research.cluster: Cluster Buying — When multiple insiders purchase simultaneously within a compressed window, subsequent abnormal return patterns have been recorded at higher intensity compared to single-insider purchases

signumMethod.title: SIGNUM Analysis Methodology
signumMethod.desc: SIGNUM collects the trailing 90 days of Form 4 filings, synthesizing <cyan>buy/sell counts, net transaction value, and 10b5-1 plan status</cyan> to auto-compute a 4-tier Sentiment classification.
signumMethod.bullish: BULLISH — Net buying dominant + high proportion of non-10b5-1 (voluntary) purchases
signumMethod.cautious: CAUTIOUS — Mixed signals, buy/sell equilibrium or includes 10b5-1 planned sales
signumMethod.bearish: BEARISH — Net selling dominant + high proportion of voluntary sales
signumMethod.neutral: NEUTRAL — No significant insider transactions within trailing 90 days

aiIntegration.title: AI Deep Analysis Integration
aiIntegration.desc: Insider transaction data is integrated as the <gold>4th analytical axis (INSIDER ACTIVITY)</gold> in AI Deep Analysis. The AI engine cross-analyzes technical structure, options positioning, and news context alongside insider behavioral patterns to deliver <cyan>more precise structural diagnostics</cyan>.

interpretation.title: Interpretation Framework
interpretation.csuiteBuy: C-level voluntary purchase — When executives purchase with personal capital outside of pre-arranged plans, it is interpreted as reflecting high conviction in the company's internal outlook
interpretation.clusterBuy: Cluster buying (multiple insiders purchasing simultaneously) — Observed as a signal with structurally higher reliability compared to individual purchases
interpretation.voluntarySell: Voluntary large-scale selling — Discretionary sales not governed by 10b5-1 plans may suggest shifts in insider short-term outlook
interpretation.tenb51: 10b5-1 plan sales — Pre-scheduled automatic transactions; the timing itself is interpreted as having limited informational value

limitations.title: Structural Limitations
limitations.desc: Limitations that must be understood when interpreting insider transaction data.
limitations.delay: Disclosure Lag: Filed within 2 business days of transaction, so up to 2 days of latency may exist
limitations.sellNoise: Sell Noise: A significant portion of insider selling is driven by non-informational motivations such as tax obligations, portfolio diversification, and personal liquidity needs
limitations.largeCap: Large-Cap Limitation: Per Lakonishok & Lee (2001), the informational value of insider purchases in large-cap stocks has been observed as limited compared to small-cap stocks
limitations.disclaimer: This data represents observation and quantification of market structure and does not constitute investment advice or trade recommendations

insiderDeepDive.guide1: <emerald>C-level voluntary purchase + cluster buying pattern</emerald> → High structural conviction from management; <gold>reliability strengthens when cross-confirmed with CONVICTION Grade A</gold>
insiderDeepDive.guide2: <rose>Multiple insiders voluntarily selling large positions + non-10b5-1</rose> → Insider short-term outlook shift observed; <cyan>institutional departure structure strengthens when accompanied by INST RADAR DISTRIBUTION</cyan>

commandGuide.gammaFlipDesc: <purple>Gamma Flip Level</purple> is the price point where dealer gamma exposure <cyan>transitions from long to short</cyan>. At this boundary, dealer hedging direction reverses — above it, dealers hedge <emerald>against price movement</emerald> (stabilizing); below it, they hedge <rose>in the same direction</rose> (amplifying). A core reference level at institutional options desks — SIGNUM delivers it to individual investors in real-time.

gammaFlip.longDesc: Price > Gamma Flip → Dealers <emerald>hedge against price movement</emerald> → Natural braking force on price swings. A <gold>volatility-suppressed range environment</gold> forms.
gammaFlip.shortDesc: Price < Gamma Flip → Dealers <rose>hedge in the same direction as price</rose> → Price moves become self-reinforcing. A <gold>volatility-amplified momentum environment</gold> forms.
gammaFlip.tip: Monitor Flip deviation (%) on the VOL REGIME card for real-time distance to regime transition. Within ±2%, regime shift is considered imminent.

indicators.title: Key Indicators Reference
indicators.desc: Definitions and <gold>structural interpretation guidelines</gold> for <cyan>core derivative and flow indicators</cyan> referenced throughout the Intel page.
indicators.gexDesc: Net gamma exposure of options dealers. In positive (+GEX) environments, dealer hedging dampens price movement for stabilization; in negative (-GEX) environments, it amplifies momentum for acceleration.
indicators.gexTrading: +GEX: Dealers hedge against price movement, forming a range-bound environment. -GEX: Dealers hedge with price movement, creating self-reinforcing trends. Sign changes (Gamma Flip) represent regime transitions.
indicators.darkPoolDesc: Percentage of total volume through institutional off-exchange trading. Above 50% indicates institutional participants bypassing public markets for block execution; cross-analysis with price direction infers accumulation/distribution.
indicators.darkPoolTrading: DP↑ + Price↓: Suggests institutional accumulation during decline. DP↑ + Price↑: Suggests institutional distribution during rally.
indicators.pcrDesc: Put option volume divided by call option volume. Below 1.0 indicates call dominance (bullish), above indicates put dominance (bearish) — an options market sentiment indicator.
indicators.pcrTrading: Extreme call dominance below 0.7 has historically preceded corrections; extreme put dominance above 1.3 has historically preceded rebounds. 0.8–1.2 is neutral, requiring cross-reference with other indicators.
indicators.squeezeDesc: When Bollinger Bands contract within Keltner Channels, volatility energy accumulates; on release (Fire), directional movement occurs. Classified as LOW/MED/HIGH.
indicators.squeezeTrading: HIGH + short gamma combination structurally elevates bi-directional sharp movement probability. At the Fire point, accumulated energy is released with directional price action.
indicators.netPremiumDesc: Call option premium total minus put option premium total. Positive indicates call-side (bullish) capital dominance; negative indicates put-side (bearish) capital dominance.
indicators.netPremiumTrading: Positive + rising volume: Institutional bullish positioning concentrating. Negative + rising volume: Institutional bearish positioning concentrating.
indicators.whaleIndexDesc: Composite indicator estimating institutional accumulation/distribution by synthesizing GEX, dark pool ratio, and block trade frequency.
indicators.whaleIndexTrading: HIGH + Analytics Grade A: Active institutional accumulation indicated — bullish environment. LOW + price decline: Institutional interest has departed — supply-absent environment.

rlsi.guide3: <rose>PARTIAL state</rose>: Some data sources missing; <cyan>cross-verification with other indicators recommended</cyan>

breadth.title: MARKET BREADTH
breadth.desc: Market breadth analyzes <emerald>advancing vs declining stock counts</emerald> to assess the structural health of market rallies. Even when indices rise, <rose>narrow participation driven by a handful of large-caps signals a fragile structure</rose> with diminished trend sustainability. The first metric institutional desks check when diagnosing overall market vitality.
breadth.guide1: <emerald>A/D ratio ≥ 2:1</emerald> → Broad participation confirmed; structurally healthy trend environment
breadth.guide2: Index new high + <rose>Breadth < 50%</rose> → Narrow large-cap driven structure; <gold>trend fatigue probability elevated</gold>
breadth.guide3: <emerald>Breadth rebounding from lows</emerald> → Participation broadening; <cyan>bottom formation indicated at transition zone</cyan>

calendar.title: ECONOMIC CALENDAR
calendar.desc: Displays schedules and <rose>estimated market impact levels</rose> for market-moving economic events including <gold>CPI, PPI, PMI, FOMC</gold>. Volatility structurally expands around <rose>HIGH-rated events</rose>.
calendar.guide1: <rose>HIGH event D-1</rose>: Volatility expansion structurally anticipated
calendar.guide2: <gold>Post CPI/PPI release</gold>: Initial 30-minute moves carry high noise probability; <cyan>directional confirmation valid at 1-hour mark</cyan>
calendar.guide3: <purple>FOMC ±1 week</purple>: VIX spikes frequently observed; <emerald>options premium expansion zone</emerald>

tactical.title: TACTICAL VERDICT
tactical.desc: AI cross-analyzes <cyan>all Guardian macro data</cyan> to produce <gold>Status</gold>, <purple>Analysis</purple>, and <emerald>Outlook</emerald> in a 3-stage output. Incorporates <rose>VIX futures term structure</rose> and <gold>bond/gold capital flow</gold> cross-analysis for advance volatility anomaly detection.
tactical.sampleCurrent: 5-day trend shows growth-favoring regime (RISK_ON_GROWTH) with capital inflows observed into value, industrials, and financials.
tactical.sampleAnalysis: Market maintains resilient flow dynamics despite FOMC minutes uncertainty, with tech sector showing relative strength driven by AI thematic concentration.
tactical.sampleAction: Growth-favoring regime and stable flow data indicate continued tech-led upward momentum in the current environment.

v9DeepAnalysis.title: Deep Macro Analysis Indicators
v9DeepAnalysis.vixTerm: VIX vs VIX3M (futures term structure): Contango (VIX < VIX3M) = stable market state; Backwardation (VIX > VIX3M) = fear spike precursor pattern
v9DeepAnalysis.bondFlow: Bond capital flow (TLT): Rally indicates safe haven preference expansion → downside risk increase indicated
v9DeepAnalysis.goldFlow: Gold capital flow (GLD): Rally indicates inflation hedge / crisis sentiment → volatility expansion environment indicated

whatIf.title: WHAT-IF SIMULATOR
whatIf.desc: Directly adjust macro variables (<cyan>VIX</cyan>, <gold>10Y yield</gold>, <emerald>Sentiment</emerald>, <purple>Momentum</purple>) to simulate their real-time impact on the RLSI score. The same What-If stress test methodology used by institutional risk managers — now accessible to every investor.
whatIf.howTo: Adjust each variable's slider to see RLSI score impact reflected instantly, providing intuitive understanding of which variables exert the greatest influence on market strength.

fedWatch.title: FEDWATCH Rate Probability
fedWatch.desc: Visualizes <cyan>federal funds rate change probabilities</cyan> based on CME FedWatch data. Tracks <emerald>rate cut</emerald>, <gold>hold</gold>, and <rose>hike</rose> probabilities for the next FOMC meeting in real time, integrated with <gold>Gravity Gauge</gold> for unified analysis of how rate expectations influence market strength.
fedWatch.guide1: <emerald>Cut probability ≥ 70%</emerald> → Market strongly pricing accommodative policy; growth/tech favorable environment
fedWatch.guide2: <rose>Hike probability trending up</rose> → Tightening expectations strengthening; downward pressure on rate-sensitive sectors
fedWatch.guide3: <gold>Probability sharp shift</gold> (≥20pp change within 1 week) → Market consensus realignment, volatility expansion zone

flowMap.title: FLOW TOPOGRAPHY MAP V3.0
flowMap.desc: Visualizes <cyan>real-time capital flows</cyan> across <purple>14 sectors</purple> (GICS 11 + <cyan>Semiconductors, Cybersecurity, Clean Energy</cyan>) through network topology. Node <emerald>size and color indicate inflow/outflow intensity</emerald>; <gold>connection lines represent inter-sector correlation</gold>. <rose>Safe Haven</rose> nodes visualize bond/gold capital flight.
flowMap.safeHaven: Yellow node (Safe Haven) = Bond/gold safe haven capital flow
flowMap.newSectors: Semiconductors (SEMIS), Cybersecurity (CYBER), Clean Energy (CLEAN NRG) — Thematic sectors added
flowMap.guide1: Capital-concentrating sectors (<emerald>large green nodes</emerald>) → <gold>Bullish structure confirmed for leading constituents</gold>
flowMap.guide2: Capital outflow (<rose>red nodes</rose>) to inflow sectors → <cyan>Sector rotation observed</cyan>
flowMap.guide3: <gold>Safe Haven node</gold> capital concentration → <rose>Risk-off environment, safe haven preference strengthening</rose>

sectorIntel.title: SECTOR INTEL
sectorIntel.desc: Provides each sector's <cyan>5-day trend</cyan>, <gold>volume intensity</gold>, and <emerald>constituent-level real-time pricing</emerald>. Quantitatively distinguishes between healthy broad-based sector advances and fragile structures driven by select individual stocks.
sectorIntel.guide1: <emerald>Sector-wide advance + volume expansion</emerald> → <gold>Broad-based bullish structure confirmed</gold>
sectorIntel.guide2: 5-day trend <cyan>negative→positive transition</cyan> → <emerald>Early reversal observed at transition zone</emerald>
sectorIntel.guide3: Sector <rose>top constituents advancing while remainder declines</rose> → <gold>Individual stock selection more valid than sector thesis</gold>

gammaShield.title: GAMMA SHIELD™ V3
gammaShield.desc: Analyzes institutional dealers' <gold>gamma hedge positions</gold> in the <cyan>S&P 500 options market</cyan> in real time to structurally assess market <emerald>volatility direction</emerald> and <rose>sudden movement risk</rose>. A proprietary SIGNUM HQ indicator making gamma analysis — previously exclusive to institutional options desks — accessible to every investor.
gammaShield.sampleInsight: S&P 6,893 — Gamma weak(+13), Squeeze 38%, ▼6,500(-5.7%) downside bias · ceiling 7,000

gex.title: Gamma Pressure (GEX Index)
gex.desc: Normalizes combined <cyan>SPY + QQQ</cyan> options gamma exposure (GEX) to a -100 to +100 scale. <gold>Positive (+)</gold>: dealer hedging stabilizes prices. <rose>Negative (-)</rose>: dealer hedging amplifies volatility. <emerald>▲/▼ trend arrows</emerald> show day-over-day GEX direction.

squeeze.title: Squeeze Risk
squeeze.desc: Measures the probability of short-gamma position holders being <rose>forced to cover (squeeze)</rose> due to sharp price movements. Explosive price movement potential structurally elevates above <gold>45%</gold>; <rose>≥70%</rose> is an extreme risk zone.

trigger.title: Trigger Band
trigger.desc: Analyzes S&P 500 <cyan>options chain open interest</cyan> to calculate institutional <emerald>price support (Put Floor)</emerald> and <rose>resistance (Call Wall)</rose>. <gold>Gamma Flip Point</gold> shows the critical price where dealers transition from long to short gamma.
trigger.resistDesc: Call OI concentration zone → Upside resistance
trigger.supportDesc: Put OI concentration zone → Downside defense

flipPoint.title: Gamma Flip Point
flipPoint.desc: The <gold>critical price</gold> where dealer positions transition from <emerald>long gamma (stable)</emerald> to <rose>short gamma (volatile)</rose>. Distance (%) from current price is displayed; <rose>within 2% proximity</rose> triggers a regime transition warning.

directionalInsight.title: Directional Insight
directionalInsight.desc: Outputs dynamic, real-time data-driven insights with <cyan>price targets and directional bias</cyan> in the header. <gold>GEX intensity</gold>, <emerald>squeeze level</emerald>, <rose>directional bias and price targets</rose> are immediately visible.

aiIntegration.title: AI Integration
aiIntegration.desc: Gamma Shield data (GEX, Squeeze, support/resistance) feeds directly into <cyan>Tactical Insight AI</cyan>, enabling RLSI + Breadth + macro + <gold>options structure</gold> synthesis for automated comprehensive analysis.

gammaShield.insightDesc: GAMMA SHIELD V3 auto-generates <cyan>current data-based directional insights</cyan> displayed in the header. Example insights by scenario:
gammaShield.insightLong: S&P 6,893 — Gamma strong(+45), Squeeze 12%, ▲7,000(+1.6%) upside bias · floor 6,800 (GEX ≥ +20: stable, range-bound)
gammaShield.insightShort: S&P 6,893 — Gamma weak(-30), Squeeze 62%, ▼6,500(-5.7%) downside bias · ceiling 7,000 (GEX ≤ -20: vol expansion)
gammaShield.insightSqueeze: S&P 6,893 — Gamma weak(+8), Squeeze 71%, direction-agnostic sharp move imminent · capital preservation priority (Squeeze ≥ 70%)
gammaShield.insightTrigger: S&P 6,893 — Gamma neutral(+15), Squeeze 28%, ▲7,000(+1.6%) · resistance 1.2% approach — breakout = surge, rejection = pullback
gammaShield.guide1: <emerald>GEX ≥ +20 + Squeeze LOW</emerald> → Dealer hedging stabilizes prices; <gold>volatility-suppressed range-bound zone</gold>
gammaShield.guide2: <rose>GEX ≤ -20 + Squeeze HIGH</rose> → Dealer hedging amplifies volatility; <cyan>high bi-directional sharp movement probability zone</cyan>
gammaShield.guide3: <emerald>Gamma Flip Point within 2%</emerald> → Dealer regime transition imminent; <rose>position management for volatility regime shift warranted</rose>

historicalContext.title: HISTORICAL CONTEXT (30D)
historicalContext.desc: Quantifies the <gold>historical context</gold> of the current gamma structure through <cyan>DynamoDB</cyan>-backed 30-day historical data. Delivers the same level of historical analysis referenced by institutional options desks, distilled into <emerald>6 core metrics</emerald>.

gexPercentile.title: GEX 30D Percentile
gexPercentile.desc: Displays the current GEX value's <cyan>position within the 30-day distribution</cyan> as a percentile. Below 25th indicates historically low gamma exposure (weak); above 75th indicates historically elevated gamma exposure (strong).
gexPercentile.low: ≤ 25th — Dealer gamma exposure at historical lows; volatility amplification environment
gexPercentile.high: ≥ 75th — Dealer gamma exposure at historical highs; stabilization environment

regimeStreak.title: Regime Streak
regimeStreak.desc: Displays the number of consecutive sessions the current <gold>POSITIVE (long gamma) or NEGATIVE (short gamma) regime</gold> has been maintained. Longer regime duration structurally indicates that the volatility regime has stabilized.
regimeStreak.extended: Extended beyond average — Elevated volatility magnitude observed at regime transitions

regimeShifts.title: Regime Shifts
regimeShifts.desc: Count of <rose>POSITIVE ↔ NEGATIVE regime transitions</rose> within the 30-day window. Higher frequency indicates structural market instability; 0 indicates sustained single-regime stability.
regimeShifts.stable: 0 shifts — Single regime maintained for 30 days; structural stability confirmed
regimeShifts.unstable: 3+ shifts — Frequent regime transitions; directional uncertainty observed

cwHitRate.title: CW Hit Rate (Call Wall Reliability)
cwHitRate.desc: The percentage of sessions where the <cyan>Call Wall (call OI concentration resistance)</cyan> effectively capped price. Calculated as the ratio of sessions where price remained below Call Wall, <gold>quantifying resistance structural reliability</gold>.
cwHitRate.high: ≥ 80% — High resistance reliability; structural ceiling observed
cwHitRate.low: < 50% — Weakened resistance; structural probability of breakout elevated

pfHitRate.title: PF Hit Rate (Put Floor Reliability)
pfHitRate.desc: The percentage of sessions where the <emerald>Put Floor (put OI concentration support)</emerald> effectively defended price. Calculated as the ratio of sessions where price remained above Put Floor, <gold>quantifying support structural reliability</gold>.
pfHitRate.high: ≥ 80% — High support reliability; structural floor observed
pfHitRate.low: < 50% — Weakened support; structural probability of breakdown elevated

cwTrend.title: CW Trend (Call Wall Direction)
cwTrend.desc: Displays the <cyan>daily directional movement and magnitude (pt)</cyan> of the Call Wall. Rising (↑) suggests institutions are adjusting overhead resistance upward; falling (↓) suggests downward adjustment.
cwTrend.up: ↑ Rising — Institutional positioning expanding upward; resistance retreating
cwTrend.down: ↓ Falling — Institutional positioning contracting downward; resistance approaching

historicalContext.guide1: <emerald>Percentile 75th+ + Extended Streak</emerald> → Stable long gamma environment structurally confirmed; <gold>volatility-suppressed range zone</gold>
historicalContext.guide2: <rose>Percentile ≤ 25th + 3+ Shifts</rose> → Unstable short gamma environment; <cyan>bi-directional sharp movement risk structurally elevated</cyan>
historicalContext.guide3: <emerald>CW/PF Hit Rate ≥ 80%</emerald> → Options wall structural reliability high; <gold>level-based structural analysis valid</gold>

strategy.title: Structural Analysis Workflow
strategy.desc: A 4-step process for systematically interpreting Guardian's complete dataset to diagnose market structure — from macro environment to micro-level analysis.

step1.title: Step 1: Market Temperature Assessment
step1.desc: Review <gold>Fear & Greed</gold> + <rose>VIX</rose> + <cyan>DXY</cyan> status bar to assess the market's current risk profile. <emerald>Extreme fear/greed zones</emerald> represent structural inflection points.

step2.title: Step 2: Macro Environment Diagnosis
step2.desc: Verify macro structural health via <gold>Gravity Gauge</gold> + <purple>Reality Check</purple> + <emerald>Market Breadth</emerald>. <cyan>Broad participation + stable rates</cyan> indicate a bullish environment.

step3.title: Step 3: Sector Flow Observation
step3.desc: Identify capital-concentrating sectors via <purple>Flow Topography Map</purple> + <cyan>Sector Intel</cyan>. Read <gold>sector rotation direction</gold> and analyze leading constituents of inflow sectors.

step4.title: Step 4: AI Comprehensive Analysis Review
step4.desc: <emerald>Tactical Verdict</emerald> and <cyan>RLSI Insight</cyan> AI analysis provides final market environment assessment. Combining with <gold>Dashboard individual ticker analysis</gold> enables fully dimensional macro-micro integrated analysis.

Financial market participation involves risk of capital loss. Historical data and indicators do not guarantee future performance. All investment decisions are made at the user's sole discretion.

flowGuide.subtitle: Full options chain analysis — institutional-grade options intelligence system
flowGuide.overviewDesc: <cyan>FLOW RADAR</cyan> analyzes real-time options chains to provide integrated structural diagnosis of <gold>institutional, large-participant, and dark pool</gold> positioning within a comprehensive options intelligence system. Organized across 3 progressive levels from AI Verdict to individual order flow.
flowGuide.level1Desc: Synthesizes 4 core indicators to <cyan>automatically diagnose directional structure</cyan>. Based on OPI (delta pressure), ATM IV (volatility temperature), Composite Index, and Whale Position, the system outputs <gold>BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL</gold> verdicts.

opi.title: OPI (Options Pressure Index)
opi.desc: <cyan>OPI</cyan> measures directional pressure by aggregating <gold>delta × OI (open interest)</gold> across calls and puts. Positive values indicate call (bullish) dominance; negative values indicate put (bearish) dominance.
opi.strongCall: +50 or above: Strong call dominance — bullish structure confirmed
opi.call: +20 to +50: Call dominance — moderate upward pressure
opi.put: -20 or below: Put dominance — bearish pressure observed
opi.tip: Sudden OPI direction reversal is interpreted as an early signal of position restructuring. Cross-verification with GEX Regime is analytically valid.
opi.guide1: OPI +50+ with GEX STABLE → Strong upward pressure confirmed in a stabilizing dealer environment
opi.guide2: OPI rapid reversal (- → +) → Early position change signal indicating directional transition
opi.guide3: OPI neutral + elevated IV → Directionally undetermined state with volatility expansion observed

atmIv.title: ATM IV (At-The-Money Implied Volatility)
atmIv.desc: <gold>ATM IV</gold> represents the implied volatility of the nearest-to-money options, reflecting <rose>the market's embedded expectation of future price movement magnitude</rose>. Current IV levels help assess the relative pricing of option premiums.
atmIv.veryLow: 0-20%: Very low volatility — premium contraction zone
atmIv.high: 60-80%: High volatility — premium expansion, event-reflecting zone
atmIv.veryHigh: 80-100%: Extreme volatility — major event reflected, maximum premium expansion
atmIv.tip: IV above 60% indicates a high volatility environment where premiums are structurally elevated.
atmIv.guide1: IV < 30% → Premium undervaluation zone; volatility expansion would drive premium growth
atmIv.guide2: IV > 70% → Premium overvaluation zone; IV Crush (contraction) probability structurally elevated
atmIv.guide3: IV spike followed by decline → IV Crush in progress; premium compression observed

composite.title: Composite Index
composite.desc: <purple>Composite Index</purple> applies weighted aggregation to <cyan>all signals</cyan> including OPI, ATM IV, Whale Position, and GEX, producing a composite analysis metric on a 0-100% scale. This is the final computational basis for AI Verdict.
composite.bearish: Below 30%: Bearish — AI Verdict outputs BEARISH
composite.tip: At extreme values (below 20% or above 80%), data consensus is strong, but mean-reversion probability also structurally increases.
composite.guide1: 70%+ + OPI positive → Multiple signals converging; bullish consensus confirmed
composite.guide2: Crossing 50% threshold → Directional transition indicated; volatility expansion environment
composite.guide3: Below 30% + IV spike → Extreme downside pressure with panic simultaneously observed

whale.title: Whale Position (Institutional Position)
whale.desc: <emerald>Whale Position</emerald> analyzes net call/put positioning from <gold>$50K+ premium large options trades</gold>. Tracks institutional directional positioning to identify smart money flow direction.
whale.long: LONG: Call premium > Put premium — institutional upside positioning
whale.short: SHORT: Put premium > Call premium — institutional downside positioning
whale.neutral: NEUTRAL: Call ≈ Put — institutional direction undetermined or neutral position
whale.tip: Institutional premium exceeding $1M is interpreted as a high-conviction position. Individual details are available in Classified Order Flow.
whale.guide1: Whale LONG + OPI positive → Institutional positions and options flow converging in same direction
whale.guide2: Whale and OPI in opposite directions → Mixed signals; additional data verification required
whale.guide3: Whale premium rapid change → Emergency institutional position adjustment indicated

flowGuide.level2Desc: Four core indicators diagnosing the structural state of the options market. Analyzes <gold>dark pool activity, short volume, put/call ratio, and gamma regime</gold> to assess market microstructure.

darkPool.title: Dark Pool %
darkPool.desc: <purple>Dark Pool %</purple> represents <gold>off-exchange institutional trading (ATS) weight</gold>. Indicates institutional block trading activity levels; higher percentages reflect more active institutional involvement.
darkPool.high: 55%+: Active institutional block trading — large position building/unwinding zone
darkPool.normal: Below 45%: Retail-dominant environment — individual participant driven
darkPool.tip: Dark Pool 60%+ combined with flat price action is interpreted as an institutional accumulation pattern.
darkPool.guide1: DP 60%+ + flat price → Institutional accumulation indicated; directional breakout may precede
darkPool.guide2: DP surge + declining price → Institutional selling observed; downside pressure environment
darkPool.guide3: DP low + volume surge → Retail-driven rally; structural sustainability unconfirmed

shortVol.title: Short Volume %
shortVol.desc: <rose>Short Volume %</rose> represents <gold>short selling as a percentage of total volume</gold>. Higher levels indicate stronger downside pressure, though elevated short positions also serve as potential short-covering rally fuel.
shortVol.high: 50%+: Excess short selling — downside pressure or short-cover rally potential
shortVol.elevated: 40-50%: Alert level — increasing short trend observed
shortVol.normal: Below 40%: Normal range — no anomalies detected
shortVol.tip: Short Vol 50%+ combined with rising price is an observed pattern of short-covering rally in progress.
shortVol.guide1: Short 50%+ + rising price → Short squeeze observed; momentum expansion environment
shortVol.guide2: Short 50%+ + declining price → Downside pressure reinforced; decline acceleration observed
shortVol.guide3: Short Vol sharp decline → Short covering in progress; reversal signal interpretation

pcRatio.title: P/C Ratio (Put/Call Ratio)
pcRatio.desc: <cyan>P/C Ratio</cyan> quantifies market sentiment via <gold>put volume ÷ call volume</gold>. Above 1.0 indicates put-dominant (bearish sentiment); below 0.7 indicates call-dominant (bullish sentiment).
pcRatio.callDom: Below 0.7: Call-dominant (bullish) — excessive levels indicate overheated zone
pcRatio.putDom: Above 1.0: Put-dominant (bearish) — extreme levels indicate maximum fear zone
pcRatio.tip: P/C Ratio at 1.3+ represents a maximum fear zone that has historically preceded reversals.
pcRatio.guide1: P/C > 1.2 + price support confirmed → Historically observed as a reversal-preceding zone
pcRatio.guide2: P/C < 0.5 + sharp price advance → Overheated signal; correction probability structurally elevated
pcRatio.guide3: P/C rapid shift (0.5→1.5) → Sentiment regime change; event verification warranted

gexRegime.title: GEX Regime
gexRegime.desc: <rose>GEX Regime</rose> analyzes market makers' <gold>gamma exposure (GEX)</gold> to diagnose the market's volatility structure. STABLE indicates price stabilization; EXPLOSIVE indicates volatility amplification environment.
gexRegime.stable: STABLE: +GEX environment — market maker hedging stabilizes prices (volatility suppression)
gexRegime.transition: TRANSITION: Neutral zone — regime transition in progress
gexRegime.flipZone: FLIP ZONE: Near GEX transition point — volatility regime change imminent
gexRegime.explosive: EXPLOSIVE/EXPLODE: -GEX environment — market maker hedging amplifies volatility
gexRegime.tip: Flip Zone → EXPLOSIVE transition indicates a structurally imminent directional sharp move. Cross-reference with Implied Move is analytically valid.
gexRegime.guide1: STABLE → Range-bound environment; dealer hedging suppresses volatility
gexRegime.guide2: EXPLOSIVE → Structurally elevated bi-directional sharp movement probability
gexRegime.guide3: Flip Zone → Regime transition in progress; volatility regime change indicated

pricePosition.title: Current Price Position Analysis
pricePosition.desc: <emerald>Price Position</emerald> shows the current price's relative location between Put Floor (support) and Call Wall (resistance). Displayed as '+/- %' relative to <gold>Gamma Flip Level</gold>; above Flip Level = stable zone, below = volatile zone.

squeeze.title: Squeeze Probability
squeeze.desc: <purple>Squeeze Probability</purple> quantifies gamma/short squeeze probability from 0-100%. Synthesizes <rose>OI concentration, IV skew, institutional positions, Short Interest</rose> to quantify explosive movement probability. 70%+ is an extreme risk zone.

flowGuide.level3Desc: <rose>Classified Order Flow</rose> displays individual <gold>large orders (Whale) and dark pool (ATS) trades</gold> captured in real time. Each order's direction (CALL/PUT), premium, expiration, and strike are displayed.

classifiedWhale.title: 🐋 Whale Trades
classifiedWhale.desc: Tracks <emerald>$50K+ premium large options trades</emerald> in real time. Displays each trade's premium, strike, expiration, and direction (CALL/PUT), enabling individual-level confirmation of <gold>institutional directional positioning</gold>.

classifiedDarkPool.title: 🏦 Dark Pool Trades
classifiedDarkPool.desc: Displays large block trades executed through <purple>ATS (Alternative Trading System) dark pools</purple>. The channel used when <gold>institutions build/unwind large positions while minimizing market impact</gold>. Print price, size, and exchange codes are displayed.

battlefield.title: OPTIONS FLOW LANDSCAPE
battlefield.desc: <cyan>Options Flow Landscape</cyan> visualizes strike-by-strike <gold>put (bearish) vs call (bullish) volume</gold> in a horizontal bar chart. A core visualization for assessing put/call flow distribution centered around the current price.
battlefield.callDesc: Right green bars → Call volume. Longer bars indicate higher bullish flow concentration at that price level
battlefield.putDesc: Left red bars → Put volume. Longer bars indicate higher bearish flow concentration at that price level
battlefield.priceDesc: Blue line showing current price position. R=Resistance (Call Wall), S=Support (Put Floor)

flowGuide.sidebarDesc: 7 premium sidebar indicators for deep structural analysis. <purple>Implied Move, Put Floor/Call Wall, Smart Money, Max Pain, IV Skew, DEX, UOA</purple> provide multi-dimensional options market microstructure analysis.

impliedMove.title: Implied Move
impliedMove.desc: <purple>Implied Move</purple> is the <gold>market-embedded expected price movement range</gold> derived from ATM options pricing. Displayed as ±%, representing a 1 standard deviation (67% probability) range through expiration.
impliedMove.high: ±8%+: High movement embedded — major event (earnings etc.) reflected
impliedMove.low: Below ±4%: Low movement embedded — directionally undetermined environment
impliedMove.tip: Pre-earnings Implied Move surge reflects premium expansion. Post-release IV Crush (contraction) is frequently observed.
impliedMove.guide1: IM ±8%+: Premiums structurally overvalued; spread structure analysis valid
impliedMove.guide2: IM low: Premiums undervalued; volatility expansion drives premium growth environment
impliedMove.guide3: IM vs actual movement comparison → IM consistently exceeding actuals indicates systematic overpricing

floorWall.title: Put Floor / Call Wall
floorWall.desc: <cyan>Put Floor</cyan> is the strike with highest put OI concentration (downside support); <rose>Call Wall</rose> is the strike with highest call OI concentration (upside resistance). Functions as effective price boundaries through market maker <gold>delta hedging</gold>.
floorWall.floor: Put Floor: Maximum put OI concentration — structural downside support
floorWall.wall: Call Wall: Maximum call OI concentration — structural upside resistance
floorWall.breakout: Floor/Wall breach → Gamma acceleration amplifies directional sharp movement
floorWall.tip: Price near Put Floor suggests structurally supported zone; near Call Wall suggests structurally resisted zone.
floorWall.guide1: Near Put Floor → Structural support from put OI observed
floorWall.guide2: Near Call Wall → Structural resistance from call OI observed
floorWall.guide3: Narrowing Floor/Wall gap → Directional breakout imminent

smartMoney.title: Smart Money Score
smartMoney.desc: <emerald>Smart Money Score</emerald> quantifies institutional activity from 0-100 by compositing <gold>large trades (whale), block trades, and dark pool activity</gold> weight. 70+ indicates active institutional positioning is observed.
smartMoney.active: 70+: Active institutional activity — directional signal reinforcement
smartMoney.moderate: 40-70: Normal activity — observation or minor adjustment
smartMoney.tip: Smart Money 80+ combined with positive OPI indicates an institutional high-conviction bullish positioning pattern.
smartMoney.guide1: SM 70+ + OPI aligned → Institutional conviction positioning confirmed
smartMoney.guide2: SM surge + flat price → Institutional accumulation indicated; directional breakout potential
smartMoney.guide3: SM low + high volume → Retail-driven rally; structural sustainability unconfirmed

maxPain.title: Max Pain
maxPain.desc: <gold>Max Pain</gold> is the <rose>open interest-weighted price convergence level</rose> at options expiration. Structural incentives drive price convergence toward this level as expiration approaches.
maxPain.below: Price < Max Pain: Upward convergence pressure — gravitational pull toward Max Pain
maxPain.near: Price ≈ Max Pain: Expiration convergence zone — price maintenance environment
maxPain.above: Price > Max Pain: Downward convergence pressure — gravitational pull toward Max Pain
maxPain.tip: During options expiration (OE) week, Max Pain convergence effects are observed to structurally intensify.
maxPain.guide1: OE week: Price < Max Pain → Upward convergence pressure operating
maxPain.guide2: OE week: Price > Max Pain → Downward convergence pressure operating
maxPain.guide3: Large Max Pain vs price divergence near OE → Sharp convergence move observed

ivSkew.title: IV Skew
ivSkew.desc: <cyan>IV Skew</cyan> measures <rose>put IV minus call IV</rose>, quantifying the market's downside/upside risk asymmetry. Larger positive values indicate stronger downside hedging demand; negative values indicate upside expectation dominance.
ivSkew.fear: +5%+: Elevated downside risk — put premium expansion, hedging demand surge
ivSkew.caution: +2-5%: Alert zone — moderate downside concern reflected
ivSkew.greed: Below 0%: Upside expectation dominant — call premium relative expansion
ivSkew.tip: IV Skew at +8%+ represents a historically extreme zone where fear-level reversals are frequently observed.
ivSkew.guide2: Skew negative: Call premiums relatively overvalued
ivSkew.guide3: Skew rapid change → Cross-verify with P/C Ratio for sentiment validation

dex.title: DEX (Delta Exposure)
dex.desc: <indigo>DEX</indigo> represents <gold>dealers' (market makers') net delta exposure</gold>. Positive (+) indicates call delta excess requiring dealer sell hedging (upside resistance); negative (-) indicates put delta excess requiring dealer buy hedging (downside support).
dex.resistance: + DEX: Dealer sell hedge required → upside resistance formation
dex.support: - DEX: Dealer buy hedge required → downside support formation
dex.tip: Cross-referencing DEX with GEX Regime provides comprehensive dealer market influence assessment.
dex.guide1: DEX large positive → Dealer sell pressure forming rally resistance
dex.guide2: DEX large negative → Dealer buy pressure forming decline support
dex.guide3: DEX rapid change → Large options position change; volatility expansion indicated

uoa.title: UOA (Unusual Options Activity)
uoa.desc: <gold>UOA</gold> detects options activity where <rose>volume-to-OI ratio</rose> is anomalously elevated. This indicates event-preceding positioning or large-scale new position building.
